criteria.text: Calculates the last date to serve non-renewal notice as 27 June 2026 (60 days before the 26 August 2026 expiry), and warns that otherwise the agreement renews for 2 years.
Calculates the service credit as $4,000 (10% of the $40,000 monthly fee for 98.1% availability) and identifies that the supplier's offer of $2,000 is too low.
Identifies that the planned reorganisation may be a change of control deemed an assignment under Clause 19, requiring the counterparty's consent.

Identifies that data protection breaches are not carved out of the $1,000,000 liability cap in Clause 11, leaving the customer under-protected for data breach losses, and recommends a separate higher cap or carve-out.
Shows the service credit arithmetic (10% x $40,000 = $4,000) and flags the discrepancy with $2,000.
Gives the notice window as 60 days and as the date 27 June 2026, with days remaining from 14 April 2026 (74 days).
Gives a concrete recommended action for each issue (what to request, amend or negotiate).
